title: docs: cli.mdx `os deploy` flag table and § To a self-hosted runtime omit `--confirm-upgrade` and the "installed but not loaded" exit
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

## What is wrong

Read on `main` `604a2b3b9`. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` lags `os deploy` on a self-hosted runtime target:

1. § `os deploy` flag table (≈L3237-L3244) has no `--confirm-upgrade` row, although `os deploy` declares it beside `--confirm-access-upgrade` (`packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts` L140-L155, used ≈L339).
2. § To a self-hosted runtime, step 3 names only `--confirm-access-upgrade` as the retry after an install refusal; the upgrade refusal's `--confirm-upgrade <token>` is missing.
3. § To a self-hosted runtime, step 4 leaves out the exit 1 for a package that is installed but not loaded (live after a restart), deploy.ts ≈L346-L352.

The platform skill (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`) teaches all three after PR #31335 (#31235). Its dev listed these under other sites, and its contract review (6716322584) confirmed them. Eval 21 of `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/` names only `--confirm-access-upgrade`. That is still true, but it is narrower than the skill.

## Suggested shape

Add the flag row and the two missing cases to the page, measured from deploy.ts. Docs-only, no changeset beyond what the docs lane requires.
